remarks: Fantastic condo alternative. Conveniently located near all major amenities and just a short stroll to Stew Leonard's. Living/dining room combo with sliders leading to the large Trex deck. Galley kitchen. Remodeled full bath and one bedroom are on the main level. 2 additional bedrooms on upper level. Primary bedroom with walk-in closet and a remodeled Jack and Jill full bath. All 3 bedrooms are spacious and are newly carpeted. Tons of natural sunlight throughout the home. 1 car attached garage plus plenty of off street parking in the large driveway. Central air. Newer roof. Situated on the corner lot of a dead end/cul-de-sac street.
